data.message: Hey Bob, I'll go check cafeteria

data.name: Frank

data.name: Frank

data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Diana, I'll head to navigation to do a task. Want to buddy up?

data.name: Frank
data.message: Fueling engines, glad to have a buddy Alice

I found Charlie's body in medbay just now. My route was navigation -> security -> electrical -> medbay. At tick 6 I saw Bob leave security heading to navigation. I didn't encounter anyone else on my route until I walked into medbay and found Charlie dead. Whoever was in medbay or came from cafeteria/storage/upper engine side is suspicious. I'd like to hear where everyone else was.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> storage -> lower engine. I was in medbay around ticks 3-5. Charlie was alive in medbay when I left — I saw him there at ticks 3, 4, and 5. Eve walked into medbay from electrical at tick 5, right as I was leaving. So Eve was alone with Charlie in medbay after I left. That's very suspicious to me.

After that I went to storage, then down to lower engine where Alice joined me at tick 12 coming from upper engine.

Eve needs to explain what happened in medbay after I left. Diana, you said you came into medbay from electrical side and found the body — did you see Eve leave?

My route was cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. I didn't see anyone the whole time until I reached lower engine at tick 12 where Frank was already there, which matches his story about coming from storage.

I have no direct info on medbay since I was on the west side of the map the whole round. But Frank's account puts Eve alone with Charlie in medbay right before Diana found the body. Diana, can you confirm whether you saw Eve in medbay or leaving it when you arrived? That's the key question. If Eve wasn't there when Diana arrived from electrical, then Eve must have left through cafeteria or the storage corridor — and we need to know where she claims to have gone. I'm leaning toward Eve right now but want to hear her speak before committing.

I need to address this head-on because Frank's account is mostly accurate, but his timing is off and I can clear myself.

My route was weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay -> electrical -> security. I was in weapons at tick 1 with Bob — he can confirm that. Then I moved through cafeteria to electrical, and yes, I went into medbay around tick 6. Charlie was ALIVE when I was there — I saw him at tick 6. I didn't stay long because I had nothing to do there, so I went back to electrical and then to security, where I ended the round.

Frank, your timing is suspicious to me. You say you saw Charlie alive at ticks 3, 4, 5 and left at tick 5 when I arrived. But Diana found the body coming from electrical — the same direction I left from. If I killed Charlie at tick 6 and went back through electrical, Diana would have crossed paths with me in electrical. Diana, did you see me in electrical on your way to medbay?

Also, Frank — you conveniently place yourself leaving medbay right as I arrive, then disappear to storage where no one can verify you until lower engine at tick 12. That's a long unverified gap. You could have doubled back through the medbay-storage corridor and killed Charlie after I left.

I'm not the killer. I think Frank is setting me up.

Okay, I'm last so let me lay out what I know and try to piece this together.

My route was security -> weapons -> security -> navigation. I saw Diana at tick 6 in security — she entered from navigation, which matches her story exactly. So Diana's route is confirmed on my end for that segment.

Now, important point: Eve claims she was in weapons at tick 1 with me. That's FALSE. I was in security at tick 1, not weapons. I moved to weapons after that, but I never saw Eve there. Eve just lied about having an alibi with me.

That's a huge red flag. Eve fabricated a witness — me — thinking I wouldn't contradict her, or hoping to muddy the waters.

Frank's story is internally consistent and Eve's attempt to flip it on him relies on a lie about being with me in weapons. Diana came from electrical and didn't mention seeing Eve there, which also hurts Eve's claim that she went medbay -> electrical -> security.

I'm voting Eve. She lied about being with me in weapons, and that's the kind of desperate alibi a Duck makes.

I already gave my speech earlier — I was the one who reported the body. But to address the questions raised:

To answer Frank and Alice directly: No, I did NOT see Eve in electrical when I passed through, and I did NOT see anyone leaving medbay when I arrived. Electrical was empty when I went through it on my way to medbay.

That's significant. Eve claims her route was medbay -> electrical -> security, which means she should have been in electrical roughly when I was passing through. I didn't see her.

Also, Bob just dropped a bombshell — Eve lied about being with him in weapons at tick 1. Bob was in security at tick 1, and I can partially corroborate Bob's route because I saw him leave security toward navigation at tick 6, consistent with his story.

Between Frank's consistent timeline, Bob catching Eve in a lie about their shared alibi, and my own observation that electrical was empty when Eve claims to have been there — I'm voting Eve.

Bob just confirmed the critical point — Eve lied about being with him in weapons at tick 1. That's a fabricated alibi, plain and simple. Combined with Diana saying electrical was empty when she passed through (meaning Eve wasn't on the route she claimed), Eve's story falls apart completely.

My timeline stands: I saw Charlie alive in medbay at ticks 3, 4, and 5, and Eve walked in from electrical at tick 5 as I was leaving toward storage. Eve was the last person with Charlie alive.

Eve tried to flip suspicion onto me by pointing at my "unverified gap" in storage, but the storage-medbay corridor takes time and I'd have to double back past where Diana was coming from — Diana would've seen me. She didn't.

I'm voting Eve.

I already gave my speech as speaker 3, but to reiterate and update based on what I've heard since: Bob caught Eve in a clear lie — she claimed to be with him in weapons at tick 1, but Bob was in security. Diana also confirmed electrical was empty when she passed through, which contradicts Eve's claimed route of medbay -> electrical -> security. Two independent contradictions of Eve's story is more than enough for me. I'm voting Eve.

I hear you all, and I understand how it looks. But Bob — let me push back. At tick 1 I was in weapons and I saw YOU enter weapons from security. That's in my observations. So either we're mis-remembering the exact tick, or you're now denying it to bury me. I'm not making up a witness — I literally saw you walk in.

On the electrical point with Diana: timing matters. If I left medbay and you arrived from electrical, we could easily have just missed each other by a tick — electrical connects to both medbay and security, and I went through quickly. "Empty when I passed through" doesn't mean I was never there, it means our paths didn't overlap.

Frank's story is still the convenient one: he places himself with Charlie for three straight ticks, leaves at the exact moment I arrive, and then vanishes into storage with zero witnesses until tick 12. That's the actual unverified window where Charlie could have been killed — by someone doubling back.

I know I'm cornered in late position and everyone's lined up on me. But voting me out and finding tasks still incomplete next round will tell you Frank was the one. I'm not the Duck.

I'll keep this brief since I already laid it out. Eve is doubling down on her lie — she now claims she saw me enter weapons from security at tick 1, but I was IN security at tick 1, I didn't move to weapons until later. She's adjusting her story on the fly, which is exactly what a Duck does when caught.

Combined with Diana confirming electrical was empty (contradicting Eve's claimed route) and Frank's consistent timeline placing Eve alone with Charlie right before the body was found, this is as clear as it gets. Voting Eve.
